info.name: Room Management API
info.description:
Live checks of the API as a client sees it (docs 04 & 06). Run the folders in order.

Local prerequisites: `npm run migration:run:local && npm run db:seed` (dev accounts, password `RentalDev@2026`), `.env.local` with `AUTH_OTP_DEBUG_ECHO=true` and `THROTTLE_SENSITIVE_LIMIT=100`, app on port 5000.
Re-run: `npm run db:seed` resets the dev accounts; wait 60 s (OTP cooldown of the landlord) between runs.
CLI: `npx newman run postman/room-management.postman_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json`
